name: Don't Starve Together
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The co-op wilderness survival game. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with the surface and the caves as two shards.
startup: c=DoNotStarveTogether/config/server; printf %s "$SERVER_TOKEN" > "$c/cluster_token.txt"; cd bin64; args=(-persistent_storage_root /home/container/DoNotStarveTogether -conf_dir config -cluster server -players {{MAX_PLAYERS}}); exec 3>&1; if [ "{{CAVES}}" = 1 ]; then coproc caves { ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 "${args[@]}" -shard Caves -port {{CAVES_PORT}} 2>&1 | sed -u "s/^/[Caves] /" >&3; }; fi; ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 "${args[@]}" -shard Master -port {{SERVER_PORT}}; if [ -n "${caves_PID:-}" ]; then echo "c_shutdown()" >&"${caves[1]}"; wait "$caves_PID"; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Don't Starve Together. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 343050) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# The cluster's settings, worlds and mods are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-343050}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The cluster: cluster.ini and a Master shard, plus a Caves shard. Each file
# is written only when it's missing; the Panel sets the name, description,
# password, mode, player count and ports in them at every start.
c=DoNotStarveTogether/config/server
mkdir -p "$c/Master" "$c/Caves"
if [ ! -f "$c/cluster.ini" ]; then
    cat > "$c/cluster.ini" <<EOF
[GAMEPLAY]
game_mode = survival
max_players = 6
pvp = false
pause_when_empty = true

[NETWORK]
cluster_name = A Don't Starve Together server
cluster_description =
cluster_password =
cluster_intention = cooperative
lan_only_cluster = false

[MISC]
console_enabled = true

[SHARD]
shard_enabled = true
bind_ip = 127.0.0.1
master_ip = 127.0.0.1
master_port = 10888
cluster_key = $(tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 24 || true)
EOF
    echo "Made cluster.ini."
fi
shard() { # folder, is_master, steam port, authentication port
    [ -f "$c/$1/server.ini" ] && return
    printf '[NETWORK]\nserver_port = 10999\n\n[SHARD]\nis_master = %s\nname = %s\n\n[STEAM]\nmaster_server_port = %s\nauthentication_port = %s\n' \
        "$2" "$1" "$3" "$4" > "$c/$1/server.ini"
    echo "Made $1/server.ini."
}
shard Master true 27018 8768
shard Caves false 27019 8769
[ -f "$c/Caves/worldgenoverride.lua" ] || printf 'return {\n    override_enabled = true,\n    preset = "DST_CAVE",\n}\n' > "$c/Caves/worldgenoverride.lua"
echo "Installed Don't Starve Together build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Cluster token
variables.description: The server token from your Klei account (Games, Don't Starve Together, Game Servers), which the server needs to start.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see in the server's details.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: survival, endless (no permanent death) or wilderness (random spawns, no resurrection).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Caves
variables.description: Run the caves as a second shard, which players reach through sinkholes.

variables.name: Caves port
variables.description: The port players reach the caves on; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
